content:
The Amazon early Black Friday sale is now live and, alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, we are getting some official Apple early Black Friday deals today too. Firstly, the 2026 AirTag 2 has now returned to its lowest price ever at $17.50 each alongside some rare price drops on the latest Magic Mouse models at up to nearly 25% off, and Amazon’s best prices on Apple’s Magic Trackpad. Joining some new all-time lows going live today on Apple’s latest collection of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases at up to 40% off, we also still have the impressive $250 price drops on M5 MacBook Air, and even more waiting below.

AirPods Pro 3 $50 off, AirPods Max 2 $100 off in early Black Friday sales launching today

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Latest AirTag 2 drops back to best price ever at $17.50 each today in early Black Friday sale

AirTag 2 just dropped back to its best price ever at just $17.50 each. The Amazon early Apple Black Friday deals are live, with a major $250 price drop on M5 MacBook Air, Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, and AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, but it is now also offering all-time low pricing on Apple’s latest 2026 AirTag 2 – the single is still down at $23 but the 4-pack has now dropped to $69.99 shipped.

Amazon has been offering the single AirTag 2 listing down at $23 since late October, and that is the lowest we have tracked there for one of them, but the 4-pack is a much better per-AirTag price and it is now listed at $69.99 shipped.

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

The single at $23 is a solid deal and the lowest price we have tracked for a single AirTag 2 at Amazon since release.

The 4-pack down at $69.99 is a particularly notable deal though – we are talking about a match for the best deal ever on four of them and a price down at just $17.50 per AirTag 2. The chances of catching the single AirTag 2 listing at under $18 this Black Friday (or ever) is very slim. We might see them hit clearance pricing at some point next year or when the next-generation model comes out in who knows how long, but it is very much not in the cards for 2026.

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView is back

Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple HomeView has returned once again today. While shipping at times at Apple have gotten better on some models, Amazon is now selling it for less and delivering quicker to some regions of the country.

Official early Black Friday deals deliver rare price drops on Apple Magic Mouse at nearly 25% off

Amazon’s early Black Friday sale is now live, and just after catching the return of the best price evAmazon’s early Black Friday sale is now live, and just after catching the return of the best price ever on Apple’s latest AirTag 2 at just $17.50 each, it is now delivering some official early Black Friday deals on the latest Magic Mouse. Both the classic white and black models are down at some of the lowest prices we have tracked to date with up to nearly 25% in savings.

  • Magic Mouse White $60 (Reg. $79)
  • Magic Mouse Black $80 (Reg. $99)

Amazon is now offering Apple’s latest USB-C Magic Mouse in the classic White/Silver colorway down at $59.99 shipped. That’s just shy of 25% off and the best deal around.

The Black/Silver model comes at a $99 premium, but it too has now dropped to $79.99 shipped to match the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon.

Apple’s Magic Trackpad now sitting at Amazon all-time low pricing

There are plenty of folks out there that transform their MacBook setup at home into a docketed situation with an external mouse, keyboard, and even a separate Trackpad, ourselves included. And with the new current M5 MacBook Air down to the best prices in months at up to $250 off right now, and the new M6 MacBook Pro and touch display model now out in the wild, we wanted to highlight these relatively rare all-time lows on Apple’s Magic Trackpad in white and black.

Deals on Apple’s Magic Trackpad are incredibly rare. And while we have started to see the prices drop slowly on the latest black and white models over the last few months, we wanted to make sure the current all-time low pricing at Amazon was on the radar for folks looking to upgrade their setup:

  • Apple Magic Trackpad White $116 (Reg. $129)
